class.name: OcgBrepmeshVertex
class.brief_description: Light weighted structure representing vertex of the mesh in parametric space. Vertex could be associated with 3d point stored in external map.
class.description: ! Light weighted structure representing vertex ! of the mesh in parametric space. Vertex could be ! associated with 3d point stored in external map.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates vertex associated with point in 3d space.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates vertex without association with point in 3d space.

method.name: Initialize
method.description: Initializes vertex associated with point in 3d space.

method.name: Coord
method.description: Returns position of the vertex in parametric space.

method.name: ChangeCoord
method.description: Returns position of the vertex in parametric space for modification.

method.name: Location3d
method.description: Returns index of 3d point associated with the vertex.
